name: AutoDock Vina

steps: Choose an official release asset matching the operating system and CPU architecture.
Record its immutable release URL and digest before enabling automatic download.
Place the executable in a user-owned tool directory and run its --help command. Do not assume the Python vina bindings include the CLI executable.
install.verify_note: Run the downloaded Vina executable with --help, then record its version and file hash.

notes: The official guide explicitly separates installation of Python bindings from installation of the vina executable.
